summary: An owner at {building} checks an old operating-cost clause when computing a renewal.
realLife: New York City's 2023 order required an offset for increases under certain renewable escalator clauses unless the owner elected in writing to delete the clause on the specified terms.
gates: The case record identifies the qualifying lease clause, written election and deadline.
inGame: needs: qualifying lease clause, written election and deadline.

turns.what: The clerk keeps the election with the renewal.
turns.pulledBy: A timely deletion covers later leases

turns.what: Its charge must be checked against the guideline increase.
